text_en: At that very time there were some present who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
text_cn: 正在那时，来了几个人把有关加里肋亚人的事，即比拉多把他们的血，与他们的祭品搀和在一起的事报告给耶稣。

text_en: He asked them, “Do you think that because these Galileans suffered in this way they were worse sinners than all other Galileans?
text_cn: 他回答说：“你们以为这些加里肋亚人，比其他所有的加里肋亚人更有罪，才遭此祸害吗？

text_en: No, I tell you; but unless you repent, you will all perish as they did.
text_cn: 不是的。我告诉你们：如果你们不悔改，你们都要同样丧亡。

text_en: Or those eighteen who were killed when the tower of Siloam fell on them—do you think that they were worse offenders than all the others living in Jerusalem?
text_cn: 或如史罗亚塔倒下，而压死的那十八个人，你们以为他们比耶路撒冷的其他一切居民罪债更大吗？

text_en: No, I tell you; but unless you repent, you will all perish just as they did. ”
text_cn: 不是的。我告诉你们：如果你们不悔改，你们都要同样丧亡。”

text_en: Then he told this parable: “A man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came looking for fruit on it and found none.
text_cn: 他讲了这个比喻说：“有一个人曾将一棵无花果树，栽在自己的葡萄园内。他来在树上找果子，但没有找到，

text_en: So he said to the gardener, ‘See here! For three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and still I find none. Cut it down! Why should it be wasting the soil? ’
text_cn: 便对园丁说：你看，我三年来在这棵无花果树上找果子，但没有找到，你砍掉它罢，为什么让它荒废土地？

text_en: He replied, ‘Sir, let it alone for one more year, until I dig around it and put manure on it.
text_cn: 园丁回答说：主人，再容它这一年罢！待我在它周围掘土，加上粪；

text_en: If it bears fruit next year, well and good; but if not, you can cut it down. ’”
text_cn: 将来若结果子便算了；不然的话，你就把它砍了。”

text_en: Now he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.
text_cn: 安息日，耶稣在一会堂里施教。

text_en: And just then there appeared a woman with a spirit that had crippled her for eighteen years. She was bent over and was quite unable to stand up straight.
text_cn: 有一女人，病魔缠身已十八年了，伛偻（yǔ lǚ）着，完全不能直立。

text_en: When Jesus saw her, he called her over and said, “Woman, you are set free from your ailment. ”
text_cn: 耶稣见了她，便叫她过来，给她说：“女人，你的病已消除了。”

text_en: When he laid his hands on her, immediately she stood up straight and began praising God.
text_cn: 遂给她按手，她即刻就挺直起来，光荣天主。

text_en: But the leader of the synagogue, indignant because Jesus had cured on the sabbath, kept saying to the crowd, “There are six days on which work ought to be done; come on those days and be cured, and not on the sabbath day. ”
text_cn: 会堂长因气恼耶稣在安息日治病，便给众人说道：“有六天应当工作，你们在这些日子里可来治病，但不可在安息日这一天。”

text_en: But the Lord answered him and said, “You hypocrites! Does not each of you on the sabbath untie his ox or his donkey from the manger, and lead it away to give it water?
text_cn: 主回答他说：“假善人哪！你们每一个人在安息日，有不解下槽上的牛驴，牵去饮水的吗？

text_en: And ought not this woman, a daughter of Abraham whom Satan bound for eighteen long years, be set free from this bondage on the sabbath day? ”
text_cn: 这个女人原是亚巴郎的女儿，她被撒殚缠住已经有十八年了，安息日这一天，就不该解开她的束缚吗？”

text_en: When he said this, all his opponents were put to shame; and the entire crowd was rejoicing at all the wonderful things that he was doing.
text_cn: 当耶稣讲这话时，所有敌对他的人，个个惭愧；一切民众因他所行的种种辉煌事迹，莫不欢喜。

text_en: He said therefore, “What is the kingdom of God like? And to what should I compare it?
text_cn: 耶稣又说：“天主的国相似什么？我要把它比作什么呢？

text_en: It is like a mustard seed that someone took and sowed in the garden; it grew and became a tree, and the birds of the air made nests in its branches. ”
text_cn: 它相似一粒芥子，人取来种在自己的园中，它遂生长起来，成了大树，天上的飞鸟都栖息在它的枝头上。”

text_en: And again he said, “To what should I compare the kingdom of God?
text_cn: 他又说：“我要把天主的国比作什么呢？

text_en: It is like yeast that a woman took and mixed in with three measures of flour until all of it was leavened. ”
text_cn: 它相似酵母，女人取来藏在三斗面中，直到全部发酵。”

text_en: Jesus went through one town and village after another, teaching as he made his way to Jerusalem.
text_cn: 耶稣经过城市乡村，随处施教，朝着耶路撒冷走去。

text_en: Someone asked him, “Lord, will only a few be saved? ” He said to them,
text_cn: 有一个人给他说：“主，得救的人果然不多吗？”耶稣对他们说：

text_en: “Strive to enter through the narrow door; for many, I tell you, will try to enter and will not be able.
text_cn: “你们竭力由窄门而入罢！因为将来有许多人，我告诉你们：要想进去，而不得入。

text_en: When once the owner of the house has got up and shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, open to us, ’ then in reply he will say to you, ‘I do not know where you come from. ’
text_cn: 及至家主起来把门关上，你们在外面站着，开始敲门说：主，请给我们开门罢！他要回答你们说：我不认识你们是哪里的。

text_en: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank with you, and you taught in our streets. ’
text_cn: 那时，你们会说：我们曾在你面前吃过喝过；你也曾在我们的街市上施教过。

text_en: But he will say, ‘I do not know where you come from; go away from me, all you evildoers! ’
text_cn: 他要说：我告诉你们：我不认识你们是哪里的；你们这些作恶的人，都离开我去罢！

text_en: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham and Isaac and Jacob and all the prophets in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves thrown out.
text_cn: 几时你们望见亚巴郎、依撒格、雅各伯及众先知在天主的国里，你们却被弃在外，那里要有哀号和切齿。

text_en: Then people will come from east and west, from north and south, and will eat in the kingdom of God.
text_cn: 将有从东从西，从北从南而来的人，在天主的国里坐席。

text_en: Indeed, some are last who will be first, and some are first who will be last. ”
text_cn: 看罢！有最后的将成为最先的，也有最先的将成为最后的。”

text_en: At that very hour some Pharisees came and said to him, “Get away from here, for Herod wants to kill you. ”
text_cn: 这时刻，有几个法利塞人前来给耶稣说：“你离开这里走罢！因为黑落德要杀你。”

text_en: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox for me, ‘Listen, I am casting out demons and performing cures today and tomorrow, and on the third day I finish my work.
text_cn: 耶稣给他们说：“你们去告诉这个狐狸罢！看，我今天明天驱魔治病，第三天就要完毕。

text_en: Yet today, tomorrow, and the next day I must be on my way, because it is impossible for a prophet to be killed outside of Jerusalem. ’
text_cn: 但是，今天明天以及后天，我必须前行，因为先知不宜死在耶路撒冷之外。

text_en: Jerusalem, Jerusalem, the city that kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to it! How often have I desired to gather your children together as a hen gathers her brood under her wings, and you were not willing!
text_cn: 耶路撒冷，耶路撒冷，你屡次残杀先知，用石头击毙那些奉命到你这里来的人；我多少次愿意聚集你的子女，如母鸡聚集自己的雏鸡，在它翅翼下，可是你们偏不愿意。

text_en: See, your house is left to you. And I tell you, you will not see me until the time comes when you say, ‘Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord. ’”
text_cn: 看罢！你们的房屋必给你们撇下；但是，我告诉你们：你们断不能再看见我，直到你们说：因主名而来的，当受赞颂的时刻来到。”
